import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import OrderedDict, defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ================= 1. SASA of Der p 23 (4ZCE chain A) and tachycitin (1DQC) =================
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
MAXASA={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLU':223,'GLN':225,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,
 'ILE':197,'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,'TYR':263,'VAL':174}
RING={'PHE':['CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ'],'TYR':['CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ'],
      'TRP':['CD2','CE2','CE3','CZ2','CZ3','CH2','CG','CD1','NE1'],'HIS':['CG','ND1','CD2','CE1','NE2']}
def parse_pdb(t,chains):
    out=[];on=True
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith("MODEL"): on=int(l.split()[1])==1
        if l.startswith("ENDMDL"): on=False
        if not on or not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        if l[21] not in chains: continue
        out.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),
                        xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])),
                        el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0])))
    return out
def sasa(at,n=720,p=1.4):
    x=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in at]); r=np.array([RAD.get(a['el'],1.8) for a in at])+p
    i=np.arange(n)+.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**.5)*i
    s=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
    d=np.linalg.norm(x[:,None]-x[None],axis=-1); o=np.zeros(len(at))
    for k in range(len(at)):
        nb=np.where((d[k]<r[k]+r)&(np.arange(len(at))!=k))[0]; pts=x[k]+r[k]*s
        acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-x[nb][None],axis=-1)>=r[nb][None]).all(1) if len(nb) else np.ones(n,bool)
        o[k]=4*np.pi*r[k]**2*acc.mean()
    return o
def aromtab(pdbid,chain):
    t=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pdbid}.pdb",timeout=120).text
    at=parse_pdb(t,[chain]); s=sasa(at); rec=defaultdict(lambda:{'ring':0.,'tot':0.})
    for a,v in zip(at,s):
        k=(a['resi'],a['resn']); rec[k]['tot']+=v
        if a['resn'] in RING and a['name'] in RING[a['resn']]: rec[k]['ring']+=v
    return {k:v for k,v in rec.items() if k[1] in RING}
d23=aromtab('4ZCE','A'); tc=aromtab('1DQC','A')

# ================= 2. CBM14 register across Acari =================
def up_fasta(q,size=500):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={'query':q,'size':size,'format':'fasta'},timeout=120)
    s={};n=None
    for l in r.text.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith(">"): n=l[1:]; s[n]=""
        elif n: s[n]+=l.strip()
    return s
pool=up_fasta('(xref:pfam-PF01607) AND (taxonomy_id:6933) AND (length:[40 TO 200])')
CAN=re.compile(r"C(.{10,22})C(.{3,8})C(.{6,14})C(.{8,20})C(.{3,12})C")
AROM=set("FYWH")
cols=defaultdict(list)
n_can=0
for nm,s in pool.items():
    m=CAN.search(s)
    if not m: continue
    n_can+=1
    g1,g2,g3=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
    for o,res in enumerate(g1,1): cols[('C1',o)].append(res)
    for o,res in enumerate(g2,1): cols[('C2',o)].append(res)
    for o,res in enumerate(g3,1): cols[('C3',o)].append(res)

# Der p 23 register (C1=47 missing C2 at 61, C3=66, C4=76, C5=89, C6 absent)
DERP23="MKFNIIIVFISLAILVHSSYAANDNDDDPTTTVHPTTTEQPDDKFECPSRFGYFADPKDPHKFYICSNWEAVHKDCPGNTRWNEDEETCT"
reg={}
for o in range(1,14): reg[('C1',o)]=47+o          # C1 block: 48..60 (13 residues, canonical 16)
for o in range(1,5):  reg[('C2',o)]=61+o          # pseudo-C2 at 61 -> 62..65
for o in range(1,10): reg[('C3',o)]=66+o          # 67..75
rows=[]
for k,pos in reg.items():
    v=cols.get(k,[])
    if len(v)<100: continue
    aa=DERP23[pos-1]
    ring=d23.get((pos,{'F':'PHE','Y':'TYR','W':'TRP','H':'HIS'}.get(aa,'')), {}).get('ring',np.nan)
    rows.append(dict(block=k[0],offset=k[1],derp23_pos=pos,derp23_aa=aa,
                     arom_freq=sum(r in AROM for r in v)/len(v), n=len(v),
                     derp23_arom=aa in AROM, ring_sasa=ring))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(['block','offset'])
print("canonical 6-Cys Acari CBM14 domains used:",n_can,"of",len(pool))
print(R.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.2f}"))

# ================= 3. figure =================
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(17,5))
# A: aromatic ring exposure
a=ax[0]
lab=[f"{{'PHE':'F','TYR':'Y','TRP':'W','HIS':'H'}}" for _ in []]
m3={'PHE':'F','TYR':'Y','TRP':'W','HIS':'H'}
dd=sorted([(k[0],m3[k[1]],v['ring']) for k,v in d23.items()])
tt=sorted([(k[0],m3[k[1]],v['ring']) for k,v in tc.items()])
a.bar(range(len(dd)),[x[2] for x in dd],color=['#2b6cb0' if x[2]>=15 else '#b0b7c3' for x in dd])
a.set_xticks(range(len(dd))); a.set_xticklabels([f"{x[1]}{x[0]}" for x in dd],rotation=90)
a.axhline(15,ls='--',c='k',lw=.8); a.set_ylabel("Exposed aromatic ring SASA (A$^2$)")
a.set_title("Der p 23 (PDB 4ZCE chain A)\n4 of 10 aromatic rings solvent exposed")
# B: tachycitin
b=ax[1]
b.bar(range(len(tt)),[x[2] for x in tt],color=['#2f855a' if x[2]>=15 else '#b0b7c3' for x in tt])
b.set_xticks(range(len(tt))); b.set_xticklabels([f"{x[1]}{x[0]}" for x in tt],rotation=90)
b.axhline(15,ls='--',c='k',lw=.8); b.set_ylabel("Exposed aromatic ring SASA (A$^2$)")
b.set_title("Tachycitin (PDB 1DQC, chitin binder)\n8 of 13 aromatic rings solvent exposed")
# C: conservation vs Der p 23
c=ax[2]
xs=np.arange(len(R)); c.bar(xs,R.arom_freq,color='#cbd5e0')
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(R.iterrows()):
    col='#c53030' if r.derp23_arom else '#718096'
    c.text(i,r.arom_freq+0.02,f"{r.derp23_aa}{r.derp23_pos}",ha='center',fontsize=7,color=col,rotation=90)
c.set_xticks(xs); c.set_xticklabels([f"{r.block}+{r.offset}" for _,r in R.iterrows()],rotation=90,fontsize=7)
c.set_ylim(0,1.15); c.set_ylabel("Fraction aromatic (F/Y/W/H) in %d Acari CBM14"%n_can)
c.set_title("Aromatic conservation per CBM14 register position\n(red = Der p 23 residue is aromatic)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
